Explain in simple languageA visual dashboard of the birth chart you saved on the Kundli page — charts, tables and graphs on one screen.

What this page is

This page draws the chart you last saved on the Kundli page as a set of cards: the chart diagrams, planet table, strengths, periods and other graphs.

How to use it

First cast and save a chart on the Kundli page. Then open this page and it loads that chart. The settings panel can re-calculate it with a different ayanāṃśa or house system.

How to read what you see

Each card covers one part of the chart. Hover over or tap the graphs for exact values.

A word of care

The chart is stored only in this browser on this device.
